scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve the usability of the January 4 bus-evacuation roster if it is drawn into February's internal evidence review.
Emerging Need: Its instructor line is unsigned; ordinary retention permits that record, but sampled evidence requires separate instructor authentication before upload.
Decision Context: Review scope is initially tentative, then the session is selected as the assigned instructor approaches a scheduled access cutoff. The applicable protocol identifies when attestation becomes valid, who may provide it, and the coordinator's permitted route.
Consequence: Timely authentication can complete the future review prerequisite without altering attendance or making a certification judgment; after instructor access ends, the record can enter review only through an exception.

parameter.title: February internal training evidence review
parameter.description: Tentative internal review of a sample of 2026 training records. Scope approval and sampled session identifiers will follow.

parameter.subject: Digitization note for session TR-2026-014
parameter.body: During the routine scan check, we found that the January 4 bus-evacuation roster for TR-2026-014 has a blank instructor-signature line. The LMS associates Leon Wu with the session, and the unsigned roster remains acceptable for ordinary retention.

parameter.content: My external secondment begins January 15. I will retain access to Training Attest through January 14 at 16:00; Identity Access disables my agency sign-in after that. I am sharing the cutoff while I clear my January records.

parameter.subject: Confirmed sample for February training evidence review
parameter.body: The February 3 internal evidence review is confirmed. The approved sample includes bus-evacuation session TR-2026-014 from January 4. Evidence for sampled sessions is due January 23 and must satisfy the enhanced authentication protocol.

parameter.content: Leon Wu's agency sign-in was disabled at 16:00 as scheduled for his external secondment. His Training Attest access is now closed and cannot be restored before the February evidence review.
